text:
alex: quick sync idea: short-lived request header to let clients opt into v3 semantics during v4 cutover. header: `X-RW-Compat: v3` + `X-RW-Compat-TTL: seconds`. keep it temporary, observable.

marta: pragmatic. q's: tenant-level opt-in vs request-only? streaming routes?

alex: propose tenant opt-in gate (default off) + request header with TTL. router rejects for streaming endpoints.

samir: perf note: proxy-side translation adds ~1-3ms and CPU. limit usage, measure impact before broad roll.

alex: enforce tenant flag + migration window; outside window -> 403. clamp TTL max (e.g., 600s).

marta: add telemetry: `compat.header.used`, `compat.result` (translated|passthrough|rejected), and trace tag. emit per-version counters.

samir: streaming exclusion: return 400 for streaming routes with migration link. frames are brittle.

alex: implementation: small `compat-bridge` in front of runtime rewrites request shapes for non-stream routes. fallback configurable per-tenant: fail-open (warn header) vs fail-closed (reject). default fail-open.

marta: include response header `X-RW-Compat-Result` so infra and customers can detect translation. example request/response in RFC.

samir: billing: translations may change token counts. billing pipeline must use post-translation token deltas and regression tests to avoid double-counting.

alex: will add billing integration, regression tests, perf microbench (targets: p50 added latency <2ms at 10k RPS, p95 <7ms).

marta: require security sign-off for translation rules touching metadata/PII.

samir: cache rules in-memory for low latency; need invalidation path when tenant toggles. local cache + push invalidation + cache metrics.

alex: add sunset policy: escape-hatch expires after N days or on cutover date; extensions via support only.

marta: canary plan: enable for one low-volume tenant, watch errors/latency/token deltas, then expand.

ops-bot: deploybot: rolling deploy of compat-bridge v0.1 to staging at 1718765200 :rocket:

marta: overall this looks like a controlled short-term shim that avoids permanent compatibility debt if TTLs & windows are enforced. :thumbsup:
